text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so surprised! I... I actually 
won...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to how much thought you 
put into helping me win, Trainer... and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer told me I was amazing... So that 
means a gold star for both of us, right? ♪
